bagPolicy.summary: People and bags are subject to visual searches and metal detector screening; the general Know Before You Go page does not set a universal bag-size limit. Check your concert page because individual shows may impose a clear-bag rule.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The Fabulous Fox Garage directly across Washington Avenue at 3637 Washington Boulevard offers parking for $20 per car; its clearance is 8 feet 2 inches.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The Fox arrival and parking pages do not designate a rideshare pickup location.

concessions.summary: Concession stands sell snacks, nonalcoholic drinks and alcohol at performances. Outside food and beverages are prohibited.
